## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` is green
- [ ] `just doctor` is green (run locally; CI does not run it)
- [ ] `just site-check` is green (site changes only)
- [ ] No secrets, keys or tokens in the diff, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Every file ≤150 lines, `notes/*.md` ≤30 lines
- [ ] No copyrighted art (test rosters live in `packs/local/`, gitignored)
- [ ] README verbs table / docs updated if a verb or recipe changed
